thread:
Sam C: Morning — opened PR #4321 to add optional "session_metadata" header passthrough to our SDKs (JS/Go/Python). It's behind a flag but needed for toolcall streaming retries. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/4321
Sam C: This touches the client header forwarding layer — low-risk but the Go shim needs a small API shape tweak. CI failing on go-integration on Windows (timeout), looks unrelated to the change.
Maya R: thx — can you summarize the Go change? I don't have context to approve.
Sam C: Go change: rename ToolCallHeaders.ForwardMeta -> ForwardMetadata to avoid collision with existing struct method. Small rename in surface; tests updated. Example diff:
```go
type ToolCallHeaders struct {
  // old: ForwardMeta bool
  ForwardMetadata bool
}
```
Maya R: ok that looks fine. Will waiting on Jeff for SDK cross-language signoff.
Jeff P: reviewing now. quick question — is the flag off by default in hosted? we should avoid any user-facing rollout until Dedicated teams opt-in.
Sam C: flag default = off for hosted; Dedicated and Private can opt in via config. Added note in PR description and SDK changelog.
Luis G: CI Bot just reran flaky suite; CI Bot: go-integration timed out on docker network setup. @CI Bot can you paste the failing command?
CI Bot: Failed command: docker exec -i test-container /bin/sh -c "make integration-test" — timeout after 15m. Requeued job 3.
Jeff P: re-ran local unit tests — small linter nit in js-client that I'll comment on. otherwise LGTM pending docs update.
Sam C: docs update added (usage + migration paragraph). merge window today at 18:00 PT if approvals in place — can someone take a look before then?
Maya R: I can approve after Jeff's comments addressed.
Jeff P: pushed a tiny fix. leaving approval now. :thumbsup: 
Sam C: thanks all — marking for merge queue. will monitor dedicated e2e after deploy.
